authorized: freeze translation-depth oracle and same-support R3 baseline estimands
freeze object-approach positive-control geometry, roles and independent identities
freeze coordinate, unit, warp, visibility, valid-mask and local-fit audit rules
freeze cluster-level analysis, stop rules, independent validation and activation decision
forbidden: generate, read, summarize or interpret any Stage B RCLE response
run a Stage B render, track, local-fit or analysis workload
modify R3, strict 0.01 per second, three-pair logic, PairState or abstention reset
activate the full-6DoF interaction branch from Stage A
enter feature contract C or fusion experiment D
run, read or consume the successor formal 480 plus 16 identities
claim real-scene, monocular-depth, IMU, Android, product, alarm, danger or safety validity

research_question: On source-known metric depth and camera pose, does a translation-depth oracle remove camera-translation residual expansion on static geometry while preserving independently moving object-approach expansion, conditional on a must-pass rotation-leakage boundary?

design.paired_repeated_measures: five render arms and two analysis channels within each frozen cluster

OBJECT_APPROACH_PLUS_EGO_6DOF.role: combined positive-control retention boundary; not a Stage A interaction branch

baseline.definition: unchanged R3 current-to-previous rotation warp, unchanged sparse tracking, unchanged common-cell selection and unchanged local affine fit

oracle.definition: on the exact baseline track candidates and paired valid support, subtract only the source-known camera-translation endpoint displacement in the R3 rotation-compensated coordinate frame, then rerun the unchanged local affine fit

analysis_channels.support_pairing: A track or cell enters a baseline-versus-oracle estimand only if it is valid for both channels; channel-specific support gains are not counted as oracle benefit.

translation_signed_suppression.metric: cluster compensated signed expansion P90 per second
translation_signed_suppression.direction: positive means the oracle removes positive camera-translation response

translation_absolute_leakage_suppression.metric: cluster compensated absolute expansion P90 per second

object_approach_static_camera_retention.metric: target-mask compensated signed expansion P90 per second
object_approach_static_camera_retention.formula: oracle_signed_p90 / baseline_signed_p90 when baseline_signed_p90 is strictly above 0.01 per second
object_approach_static_camera_retention.direction: larger positive ratio means the positive control is retained

object_approach_plus_ego_retention.metric: target-mask compensated signed expansion P90 per second
object_approach_plus_ego_retention.formula: oracle_signed_p90 / baseline_signed_p90 when baseline_signed_p90 is strictly above 0.01 per second
object_approach_plus_ego_retention.direction: larger positive ratio means ego subtraction did not erase target approach

rotation_absolute_leakage_boundary.metric: cluster compensated absolute expansion P90 per second and fixed-601-denominator three-pair trigger density
rotation_absolute_leakage_boundary.formula: oracle and baseline are paired on identical support; translation oracle displacement must be zero
rotation_absolute_leakage_boundary.direction: must remain at or below the unchanged 0.01 per second boundary with zero trigger density

image.pixel_coordinate: u right, v down, homogeneous pixel center coordinates

camera.rotation_unit: radian when an angle is reported
camera.depth: previous/source-frame optical camera Z in metres

pair_transform.dt_binding: depth and previous pose belong to t; current pose belongs to t+dt; dt must be finite and strictly positive

rotation_warp_contract.homography_direction: previous-to-current is supplied; its inverse is passed to cv2.warpPerspective under the existing implementation

source_requirements: finite source-known material point and object identity
finite positive current optical Z after the actual scene and object transform
actual current endpoint inside the bilinear-safe image domain
same source-known material point remains on the same object identity
actual current endpoint passes nearest-positive-Z visibility against the current z-buffer
previous generator mask, current generator mask, existing R3 warp mask and sparse-track validity all pass
visibility_and_valid_mask_contract.static_geometry_visibility: the rigidly transformed source point must match current object identity and current z-buffer depth within max(1e-7 metre, 1e-6 times projected Z)
visibility_and_valid_mask_contract.moving_target_visibility: visibility is evaluated at the actual object-transformed current material point; the camera-only counterfactual endpoint is not required to be visible
visibility_and_valid_mask_contract.occlusion: occluded, newly revealed, object-switched, behind-camera, depth-discontinuous or out-of-bounds points are invalid
visibility_and_valid_mask_contract.missingness: invalid points, pairs and cells remain abstentions; no zero fill, interpolation, carry-forward, imputation or denominator removal
visibility_and_valid_mask_contract.paired_support: baseline and oracle reductions use the exact intersection of valid track identities and common cell indices

local_fit_audit_contract.cell_membership: unchanged fixed-grid membership from previous/source feature coordinates
local_fit_audit_contract.fit: unchanged R3 local affine fit on endpoint correspondences
local_fit_audit_contract.baseline_input: previous point to observed endpoint in the R3 rotation-compensated frame
local_fit_audit_contract.oracle_input: previous point to q_oracle after per-track translation-depth subtraction
local_fit_audit_contract.required_recomputation: rerun the affine fit from oracle-corrected endpoints for every cell
forbidden: subtract an expansion scalar after the baseline fit
reuse baseline affine coefficients or residuals as oracle coefficients or residuals
change grid, minimum tracks, robust-fit parameters, threshold or common-cell rule
compare cells that are not common to baseline and oracle

object_approach_positive_control.primitive: fronto-parallel rectangle mesh with two triangles
object_approach_positive_control.motion_phase: s(tau)=0.5-0.5*cos(pi*tau), tau clipped to [0,1] over the exact 602-frame block
object_approach_positive_control.material_point_identity: fixed barycentric coordinates on the target mesh; no per-frame reselection
object_approach_positive_control.background: static deterministic non-planar scene; no other moving object
object_approach_positive_control.semantic_role: geometry-only positive control, not danger, person, collision or alarm truth
object_approach_positive_control.anti_swallow_rule: the oracle subtracts the counterfactual camera-only displacement of the previous material point and must leave the source-known object-motion displacement in the residual

independence_contract.pose_waveform_reuse: the four source periodic pose blocks are matched mechanism contexts, not independent samples
independence_contract.must_be_disjoint_from: all formal, predecessor DEV, QMS-R1 DEV/CAL/PREFLIGHT, four-block DEV and Stage A cluster, sequence, seed and token identities represented by the frozen Stage A identity authority
independence_contract.replacement_policy: no replacement, reseeding, per-block geometry edit or object-motion edit after response access

pre_response_stop: any contract, binding, identity-disjointness, coordinate, analytic warp, visibility, mask or local-fit audit failure
any Stage B output path or response artifact exists before a separate execution activation
any formal 480 plus 16 access or authority consumption
any proposed R3, threshold, three-pair, PairState or abstention change
future_execution_stop: any required cluster or arm is missing, replaced or below paired evaluable coverage
any must-pass rotation boundary cluster fails
any hash, role, material-point, z-buffer or common-support mismatch

routing_after_a_separately_authorized_co.GO_SINGLE_TARGETED_UPGRADE: all preconditions and rotation gates pass; both translation go gates pass; both positive-control arms pass in at least 6 of 8 clusters
routing_after_a_separately_authorized_co.FREEZE_AS_CONDITIONAL_RESIDUAL_FEATURE: all preconditions and rotation gates pass; both positive controls pass; translation suppression is positive in at least 4 of 8 clusters but misses a go gate
routing_after_a_separately_authorized_co.STOP_OR_DOWNGRADE_RCLE: all evidence is evaluable and rotation passes, but either positive-control arm passes in fewer than 6 of 8 clusters or translation suppression is positive in fewer than 4 of 8 clusters
routing_after_a_separately_authorized_co.B_ORACLE_NOT_EVALUABLE: geometry, identity, paired coverage, visibility, local fit, binding, firewall or rotation boundary fails

validator_must_not_import: Stage B response or workload output
